findings.text: non-blocking: capped_reference is a third copy of the fused quintic reference evaluator already owned by tests/test_sampled_flux_batching.py:47 (_sampled_flux_with_edges), so a later change to the cap arithmetic has to be mirrored by hand in both modules and the copies can drift apart.

non-blocking: capped_reference reads profile.lower_edge_increment, profile.upper_edge_increment and profile.edge_width from the object under test, so test_at_and_above_first_knot_is_bit_identical and test_upper_end_cap_is_bit_identical would keep passing if __post_init__'s edge-increment arithmetic regressed, because both sides of the assertion move together.

non-blocking: the MAST solve-point reference clamps queries to a hardcoded 0.0 rather than to the profile's first knot, so the helper silently mis-compares rather than raising if a positive-start table is ever passed to it; the MAST audit is its only caller today.
